6project.org.remark: Community nonprofit (AS208753) operated from Chicago; request form with manual review; ::/128 point-to-point and routed /80 assignments, other sizes on request; tunnel methods vary per PoP.

aarnet.edu.au.remark: AARNet (Australian academic research network) broker for the R&E community; service ended 2019-04-05.

ameri.ca.remark: Early US tunnel broker (website-only provisioning); domain dead.

ascc.net.remark: Academia Sinica Computing Centre (Taiwan) TSP broker; endpoint dead.

august.tw.remark: August Internet (Taiwan) broker with rDNS and BGP; domain no longer resolves.

bgptunnel.com.remark: Free IPv4/IPv6 BGP transit via tunnels for non-commercial and personal networks; own public ASN and prefix required (no address assignment); run by iFog GmbH (AS34927); absorbed the route48.org user base.

btexact.com.remark: BT Exact (BT research arm) tunnel service; discontinued.

cernet.edu.cn.remark: CERNET (China education and research network) broker for member institutions; tbclient CGI provisioning; service discontinued.

cht.com.tw.remark: CHTTL (Chunghwa Telecom Laboratories, Taiwan) broker; discontinued.

earthlink.net.remark: Earthlink R&D trial service; special Linksys WRT54G firmware - IPv4 IPsec tunnel with DHCPv6 prefix delegation; discontinued.

fccn.pt.remark: FCCN (Portuguese research network) broker for the R&E community; discontinued.

freetransit.ch.remark: Free non-commercial IP transit via tunnel or IXP for users with own public ASN and routable space; manual review, downstream transit forbidden. Separate paid RIPE LIR sponsorship (ASN/PI/PA) by openfactory nordic oy.

gogo6.com.remark: Freenet6/gogoSERVER (Viagenie -> Hexago -> gogo6), the second IPv6 tunnel broker in production (1999); all services halted 2016-03-23.

got-root.it.remark: Got-root community broker (Strasbourg PoP); /80 standard, /64 on donation.

iij.ad.jp.remark: Internet Initiative Japan trial tunnel broker (registration required); no longer offered.

internode.com.au.remark: Internode (Australian ISP) IPv6 trial tunnel on gogoSERVER; discontinued.

ipv6.ip4market.ru.remark: Free Russian-language mass-market broker by IP MARKET FZCO (IPv4 broker/LIR shop, Moscow rep office); static public IPv4 required; /48 per registration split into tunnel + LAN /64s; endpoint 193.0.203.203 hosted at SuperServersDatacenter Moscow (AS50113); non-commercial use only; IPv4-reachable mirror at tb.ip4market.ru; signup broken - email verification never arrives (reported 2026-10).

ipv6.sa.remark: CITC tunnel broker by the Saudi Arabia IPv6 Task Force (ddtb TSP implementation); domain no longer resolves.

ipv6now.com.au.remark: IPv6 Now Pty Ltd; tunnel service no longer offered - company continues as IPv6 consultancy/training.

ipv6vpn.ch.remark: ungleich IPv6 VPN: paid WireGuard tunnel with routed /48 (CHF 120/yr + CHF 30 setup); free for ungleich VM customers; privacy-focused, no traffic logging.

mytbs.com.my.remark: MyTBS (Malaysia tunnel broker service) with Ruby-based updater tool; discontinued.

nectec.or.th.remark: NECTEC (Thailand research agency) tunnel broker; discontinued.

nerim.net.remark: Nerim (French ISP) customer tunnel service; discontinued.

ngnet.it.remark: NGNet.It (Telecom Italia TILAB) broker with CGI client provisioning; discontinued.

renater.fr.remark: Renater (French research network) TSP broker for the R&E community; discontinued.

route48.org.remark: Community broker (custom GRE/BIRD/WireGuard/ZeroTier stack) with 35+ sponsored PoPs; project closed - site redirects to bgptunnel.com (iFog GmbH).

route64.org.remark: Non-profit fully automated tunnelbroker/peering/transit platform (VyOS+BIRD+VPP); routed /56 per tunnel, more on request; free IPv4/IPv6 transit up to 200M for own ASNs; automated BGP sessions and IRR/RPKI prefix filters.

sixxs.net.remark: SixXS (sixxsd, ISP-hosted PoPs, AICCU/TIC provisioning, credit system); sunset 2017-06-06 after 17 years.

soton.ac.uk.remark: ECS Southampton (University of Southampton) TSP broker; discontinued.

tb.cushell.com.remark: GhostTunnel (AS209552) hobby network run by Jan Siroky, Belgium; publicly reachable IPv4 required (no CGNAT); PoPs: London (Cilix Ltd / Hurricane Electric LLC), Amsterdam (PeersIX / Tritan Dev) - both online 2026-10; tunnels idle 7+ days are auto-disabled but can be re-enabled/recreated from the dashboard keeping prefix and settings.

tb.netassist.ua.remark: NetAssist (AS8772); dynamic endpoints via custom auto-update URL (<60s); BGP-enabled tunnel on email request for own AS+space; paid transit/colocation sideline; hotmail/live.com signups not accepted.

tb.tahio.eu.remark: Free dual-stack broker (Next.js/Supabase frontend, Go backend); three /64s per tunnel plus BGP-routed /48s; per-tunnel dyndns2 token for dynamic endpoints; tunnel space announced via sponsor AS198889 (JERDA-NET); hosted on gigahost.no.

tpsa.pl.remark: Telekomunikacja Polska (now Orange Polska) TIC broker for customers; discontinued.

tunnel64.net.remark: AS35100 (Patrik Lagerman); static routed /64 per tunnel; paid /48 and site-to-site product announced; nodes deployed to order; BYOIP announcements under AS35100 or own-ASN BGP.

tunnelbroker.ch.remark: Swiss BGP tunnels by Securebit AG (AS58057) for verified network operators; relaunch announced 'coming soon' (Oct 2026); no prefix assignment - own ASN and authoritative-IRR-verified space required; strict routing policy (no RADB/ALTDB, RPKI-invalid rejected).

tunnelbroker.id.remark: TunnelBroker.IO - showcase/demo of the open-source MercyCloudTeam Laravel panel; registrations accepted but the node list is empty (verified 2026-10 after account creation) - no usable endpoints; upstream repo unmaintained since 2025-01 and the referenced tunnelbroker.io domain does not resolve.

tunnelbroker.li.remark: iFog classic tunnel broker (7 PoPs across DE/GB/US/NO/ES/SG); domain dead - service folded into bgptunnel.com.

tunnelbroker.net.remark: Hurricane Electric; /64 per tunnel plus /48 on request; free BGP over tunnel on request; endpoint IPv4 must answer ICMP; dyndns2-compatible endpoint update at ipv4.tunnelbroker.net/nic/update.

tunnelbroker.netnam.vn.remark: NetNam (Vietnam); host alive (ICMP responds on 210.86.228.4 / 2401:e800::2, 443 refused) but TCP 80 times out on both stacks - web service dead (verified 2026-10); last archive.org snapshot 2017.

tunnelbroker.se.remark: Karabro AB (Swedish ISP, AS51519); free private tier 10 Mbit/s fair-use /60 (/48 on need, no BGP, non-commercial); paid tiers to 1/10 Gbit/s with full BGP and own-prefix announcement; only Swedish-registered non-VPN IPv4 endpoints; name+address+personnummer required (Swedish law); manual provisioning via ticket; SMTP ports blocked; WireGuard recommended for CGNAT.

ukerna.ac.uk.remark: UKERNA/JANET (now Jisc) tunnel broker for UK research and education; discontinued.

unix-servers.de.remark: Unix-Servers.de (German hosting provider) tunnel service; discontinued.

wanadoo.fr.remark: Wanadoo France (now Orange) TSP broker; discontinued.

xs26.net.remark: XS26 (Belgian ISP) broker with sites across BE/CZ/IT/NL/PL/SK/ZA; discontinued.

xs4all.nl.remark: XS4ALL (Dutch ISP) customer tunnel service; discontinued.
